title: Priest crown (tiare d'officiant)
medium: Gilded copper, settings of lapis lazuli, garnet, turquoise and rock crystals
description: Vajracharya priest's crown. A Newar inscription on the lower part names the commissioner, the monastery where he officiated and the monk-goldsmith who made it in 1145; the museum describes it as one of the oldest pieces of its kind in a Western museum.

title: The birth of the Buddha (Queen Maya)

description: Queen Maya standing under a tree at Lumbini with the newborn Buddha emerging from her right side; cast in three parts and assembled.

title: Bhairava, the "fearsome one" (mask)
medium: Gilded copper, encrusted turquoise, glass and rock crystal; remains of polychromy
description: Large Bhairava mask of the kind set in front of a jar of beer during Indra Jatra, the liquid flowing from the god's mouth.
